name: The daily adventurer Demo
summary:
A light and casual auto chess game. You play as a nameless being who has lost both body and memory, bound by a mission to guard the dungeon. Of course, that’s the protagonist’s mission — the player’s task is simply to enjoy this relaxing auto chess experience, which also allows you, as the hero unit, to jump into the battlefield and fight. If you’re interested in this game, we warmly welcome you to purchase the full version, and also to join our Discord community
